author: Cleo Abram
description:
During Apollo 11 astronauts reported seeing strange flashes of blue light even with their eyes closed. 

Researchers launched an investigation to figure out what was going on…

This, of course, led to a lot more questions. To find out more, subscribe!

#Apollo #Space #CosmicRays #animation #shorts
title: Astronauts Are Seeing Weird Things In Space
